login.title: Sign in
login.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryHint: One of the recovery codes you saved when you set up the authenticator.

setup.title: Set up your account
setup.description: Your administrator gave you a temporary password. Choose your own and set up an authenticator app.
setup.passwordRules: 12 to 128 characters. Not a common or breached password, and without your username or the product name.
setup.totpIntro: Scan this code with an authenticator app (for example Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.qrLabel: QR code to add Ariva to your authenticator app
setup.manualKey: Or enter this key by hand
setup.codeRefused: The code was not accepted. Check that the time on your phone is right and try the next code.
setup.recoveryIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe, away from your phone. Each one signs you in once if you lose the authenticator. They are shown only now.
setup.copied: The codes are copied. Paste them somewhere safe, then copy something else so they do not stay on this computer's clipboard.
setup.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the codes and copy them yourself.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.description: This action needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.

user.signOutFailed: Ariva could not end your session on the server. Sign out again when the network is back, or close the browser.

account.title: Account security
account.description: Your password, your authenticator app and your recovery codes

password.title: Password

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.enrolled: An authenticator app is set up for your account.
totp.notEnrolled: No authenticator app is set up for your account yet.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: New codes replace the old ones, which stop working. Enter a code from your authenticator app to generate them.

access.title: No access
access.description: Your role does not include this screen. Ask your administrator if you need it.

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: Airports, terminals, levels, checkpoints and desks of your sites
topology.readOnly: You can view the topology of your sites. Changes are made by a system administrator.
topology.deploymentWide: Airports are shared by every site; only an administrator of all sites adds or changes them.
topology.rangeHint: For example prefix D, from 1 to 22, 2 digits: D01 to D22 (at most 200).

messages.loadFailed: The topology could not be loaded: {reason}

mappings.title: Codes in other systems
mappings.description: The codes AMAN and the AODB use for this desk.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Queue, service, staff and overflow zones and their lines, on each level's floor plan
zones.readOnly: Published and retired versions never change. Start a draft to edit the zones.
zones.noRights: You can view the zones of your sites. Changes are made by the roles that own them.
zones.canvas: Floor plan with zones and lines
zones.starterZone: The zone starts as a small square in the middle of the level; drag its corners or type them in the table.
zones.starterLine: The line starts on an edge of its zone (an exit across from the entry); drag its ends along the edge or type them.
zones.vertexHandle: Corner {n} of {name} at {x}, {y} m. Arrow keys move it, Enter saves.

lineHandle.start: Start of {name} at {x}, {y} m. Arrow keys move it, Enter saves.
lineHandle.end: End of {name} at {x}, {y} m. Arrow keys move it, Enter saves.

zones.publishHint: Publishing replaces the live version for the whole site. Check the draft first; the check you saw is what gets published.
zones.checkAgain: The draft changed since the check; check it again.
zones.publishStepUp: Publishing needs a code from your authenticator app if you have not given one in the last 15 minutes.
zones.noPlan: No floor plan for this level
zones.planFile: Plan file (PNG, JPEG or SVG, at most 20 MB)
zones.planHint: The scale and origin place the image on the level: origin is where its top left corner lies, in metres.
zones.unsaved: Save or undo the changes on the plan first: publishing takes the saved draft.
zones.laneHint: The lane category whose queue this is: the immigration screen shows its wait for that lane.
zones.capacityHint: Optional, 1 to 5,000: the most people the area holds. The stream flags minutes whose occupancy is above it.
zones.capacityInvalid: The physical capacity is a whole number from 1 to 5,000, or empty.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Sensors of your sites: registry, coverage on the plan, calibration and health
devices.none: No devices at this site yet
devices.noRights: You can view the devices of your sites.

fields.allowedSources: Allowed networks (one CIDR a line; none for anywhere)

devices.footprintHint: Leave the footprint empty to use the BOQ's assumed coverage for the family and height.

credential.title: The device's credential
credential.once: Shown this once. Ariva keeps only a hash: store it in the device now. A lost credential is replaced, never recovered.
credential.copied: The credential is copied. Paste it into the device, then copy something else.
credential.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the credential and copy it yourself.
credential.confirmRotate: Replace the credential now (the old one stops within a minute)

devices.moveHint: Moving, re-aiming or reassigning the device takes it back to Commissioning until a calibration passes.
devices.calibrationHint: At or above the threshold (95 % unless set) the device goes Online.
devices.planLabel: Floor plan with the queue zones and the devices' coverage
devices.heartbeat: A device is offline after {seconds} s without a heartbeat.

alertRules.none: No alert rules at this site yet

form.noZones: This site has no published queue zones yet.

hints.minQueueLength: Only fire when at least this many people are queuing.
hints.leadMinutes: 15 to 60 minutes ahead, from the arrival wave of landing flights.
hints.escalation: Unacknowledged alerts go to the role or contact after this.

preview.truncated: Only the first 200 alerts are listed.

immigration.desksHidden: Desk and e-gate figures are border data: your role sees the lane totals above.

actions.confirmDisable: Disable and end its sessions now
